usageLimits: Single-person pose estimation; multiple people, a missing head, distances beyond about 4m, metric-accurate depth, surveillance and identity recognition are outside the model-card scope.
Sensitive to face position, scale and orientation; low light, noise, motion and face overlap can reduce quality and increase jitter.
The model card does not validate school-age learners, basketball technique accuracy, grading or safety-critical decisions.
